Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses You shall quote as per the technical specification mentioned in ATC. Your bid will be evaluated bas ed on our required specification attached in ATC. Bidder should mandatorily submit ATC complianc e statement along with the Bid. Bids without ATC compliance statement will be summarily rejecte d. Payment Clause: Payments shall be on pro-rata basis after completion of every 5 MT. Bill shall b e certified by the end user for releasing payments. Scope of work: The mixing has to be started within 48 hours after getting intimation from VSSC. Mixing to be done in phased manner (in staggered mode) as and when the residue is stock piled for one lot. The mixing has to be done on office hours and holidays also based on the requirement. Mixing should be super

vised by the contractor during the process. You shall not claim any damages, costs, charge, expenses, liabilities arising out of performance/ non-performance of service which it may suffer or otherwise incur by reason of any act/omission, negligence, default or error in judgment on part of itself and or its personnel in rendering or non re ndering the services under this arrangement. 4. The employees assigned by you to ISRO/VSSC for executing the work shall be liable for security check by the security staff of ISRO/VSSC and shall always have the right to conduct a search of ve hicle used by your employees while entering/going out of the premises or inside the premises. 5. ISRO/VSSC will make arrangements for the issue of temporary entry pass for the employees as per the written request 6. Necessary safety work permits shall be obtained from VSSC safety before executing the above works. 7. Party shall make a visit to the plant at VSSC for detailed assessment of the scope of work befor e submitting the offer if required. 8. All equipment / tools/consumables required for the work shall be arranged by the contractor. Re turnable materials brought inside the VSSC premises must be recorded at the VSSC gate. 9. No facilities for transport, canteen, safety, medical, lodging and other amenities will be provided by ISRO/VSSC to your working personnel and the contractor shall make their own arrangement for the same.
